lines.text: Time for the number one funny mystery every kid wonders about in secret!
You eat colorful food: red apples, yellow corn, orange carrots, and purple grapes!
So why does your body waste always end up looking brown?
Your liver produces a special dark green digestive fluid called bile!
Meanwhile, your body recycles millions of old red blood cells every single day!
As food journeys through twenty feet of intestines, friendly gut bacteria go to work!
They break down the bile and blood pigments into a compound called stercobilin!
This compound is naturally chocolate-brown—proving your digestive system is working perfectly!
Laugh and learn body secrets—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
